A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FakeShield study and contain complete, readable methods, equations, tables, figures and appendices. Text comparison and visual inspection support a reliable comparison, including all appendix pages.

before.justification: v1 reports original detection, localization and explanation results in Tables 1–4, robustness and ablation results in Tables 5–6 and Figure 5, and qualitative analyses in the appendix.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results and appendix analyses. Results retained from v1 still constitute original empirical outcomes of the work.

M1.justification: Sections 3.2–3.5 retain the same domain-tag-guided detection module, tamper comprehension module, SAM localization, LoRA training and loss functions. The notation edits and redrawn dataset-construction diagram do not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same PhotoShop benchmarks, FFHQ/FaceApp DeepFake data and COCO-derived AIGC-Editing data. Table 7 and Appendix A.2 retain the same training and evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within Tables 1–4 and the qualitative comparisons. The newly cited FFAA is discussed as related work but is not added to any reported experimental comparison.

E3.justification: The versions retain the same splits, dataset counts, model configurations, training schedules, ACC/F1/IoU/CSS metrics and 0.5 threshold. The JPEG/Gaussian degradation settings and ablation procedures also remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Both contain the same DTG-removal and LLM-removal ablations, JPEG/Gaussian robustness study, answer word clouds and qualitative examples. Tables 5–6, Figure 5 and Appendix A.3–A.5 provide unchanged analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or formal significance tests. The same point estimates and training curves are retained.

E6.justification: Tables 1–6, Figure 5 and appendix examples retain the same results. For example, FakeShield's IMD2020 ACC/F1 remains 0.83/0.90 in Table 1, and its DSO CSS remains 0.8873 in Table 3. Relocated figures preserve their findings.

T1.justification: Equations 1–5 preserve the same forward computations and training objectives. Added function notation such as Gdt(·) is cosmetic; no mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same novelty and capability claims concerning explainable forgery detection/localization, MMTD-Set, domain tags and performance across manipulation types. The FFAA discussion contextualizes these existing contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning domain conflicts, decoupled training, SAM's semantic capabilities and robustness are unchanged. Appendix A.1 retains the same limitations for identity switching and full-face generation, along with the same proposed future work.

D1.justification: The LLaVA-v1.5-13B configuration, LoRA settings, hardware, learning rates, batch sizes and training epochs remain unchanged. Both versions retain the same repository link, dataset-construction instructions and full appendix prompts.

R1.justification: v3 adds Huang et al. (2024), FFAA, and discusses its relationship to FakeShield's GPT-assisted dataset construction, tampering coverage and localization in Sections 2.2 and 3.1. A footnote credits its influence on Figure 2's design. Other reference changes update metadata for existing citations.

P1.justification: v3 makes localized prose additions about FFAA, adjusts notation and figure-reference wording, updates bibliography metadata, adds an affiliation and removes the submission header. The section hierarchy and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 2 is redrawn into three tampering-category rows and its caption clarifies Au/Tp terminology. Figure 4 moves from page 9 to 10, while Table 5 and Figure 5 move from page 10 to 9. Other displays are retained with limited caption and page-layout changes.

improvement.justification: v3 improves attribution and research positioning by acknowledging FFAA, explaining the relationship between the works and crediting Figure 2's design inspiration. The reorganized diagram also clarifies the construction workflow. These are modest benefits: the methods, experimental evidence, reproducibility information and appendix limitations remain unchanged.
